task.title: Update Windows Operating System
task.shortdesc: Update Windows operating system by searching for available updates in system settings. Windows defines the terms “update” for minor revisions and “upgrade” for major improvements. Both are important to accept and have the exact same process.

context.p: One of the simplest precautions you can take to avoid outdated software is updating your operating systems.

step.cmd: Select Windows Update if available; if not, your system is up-to-date.

info.note: Click “Get the latest updates as soon as they are available” to turn on or off automatic updates.
